description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
